title: Set a Google Sheets filter with AI for a specific table
h1: show the google sheets rows that match your question
description: Show the Google Sheets rows your team needs: name a table and condition, preview the range, then let a bot set its filter.
keywords: google sheets set filter with ai
claude apply google sheets basic filter
answer: **bring the unassigned applications to the top of the meeting.** the bot can filter or sort a chosen google sheets range using your condition. name the tab and table, then ask for a preview. it needs write access because the filter changes the shared sheet. want your own list? ask for matching rows in chat.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: the rows your next meeting needs.
what:
**show the rows your team needs right now.** give the spreadsheet link, tab and columns. describe the condition in ordinary words, such as applications without a reviewer. the bot sets the filter.

for a private report, ask it to read values and list matches in chat. that leaves everyone else's sheet view alone.
uses: show applications with no reviewer before a selection session
show confirmed orders in a bounded table before packing
filter the working table to the region and status your team needs

routine.message: on alternate mondays at 10:55, inspect the applications table in my linked rosehollow bursary sheet. propose a basic filter for rows whose reviewer field is empty. show the tab, range and condition here. ask me before setting it. after i agree, set the filter and report it here. never delete hidden rows or edit applicant details.
routine.needs: google sheets with read and write for reading the table and setting its filter
routine.output:
rosehollow bursary filter proposal
- tab: applications
- range: A1:H41
- condition: reviewer is empty
set this filter for the selection meeting?

steps: connect google sheets. allow table reading and setting a basic filter with read and write.
link the spreadsheet and name the tab and table. explain which values should count as empty.
ask for the proposed range and condition. keep "ask me before setting it" in the routine.
look at the visible rows after the change. **Pause** if the selection rules change before the next run.
watch: **the filter belongs to the sheet.** it is not a private report inside dusk chat.
**name the table and the rows you want.** the spreadsheet link alone leaves the bot guessing.
**the filter stays after the bot leaves.** turn it off in sheets when the review ends.

faq.q: does filtering delete rows that do not match?
faq.a: **the rows stay in the file.** the filter hides non-matching rows. keep deletion actions out of this bot's allowance.

faq.q: can i get a list without changing the sheet filter?
faq.a: **yes, ask for matches in chat.** the bot needs a value-reading action for that. set basic filter changes the spreadsheet itself.

steps: connect sheets and paste the spreadsheet link
name the tab, table and condition you want
compare the proposed range with your table before agreeing

mistakes.mistake: asking for a private list but allowing a sheet change
mistakes.fix: request matching rows in chat when other people should keep their view.

mistakes.mistake: including the wrong table in the range
mistakes.fix: match the tab and first and last columns to your table before setting the filter.

tip.text: missing applications? look for an active filter before rebuilding the list.
